integrity: Self-contained arithmetic coverage lemma, prefix-inheritance proof, complete pair witnesses, and two independently implemented enumeration algorithms; no unseen computation or unproved extrapolation used.
scientific_limitations: Proves the 31 exact integer thresholds only for the regular binary paperfolding word and iteration depths 1 through 31. No arbitrary-k formula, other automatic-word extension, or independent audit is claimed. The first threshold was proved and the next four were conjectured numerically in the primary reference.
title: Exact paperfolding tortoise-injectivity thresholds through 31 iterations
